blind_spots: gods laugh near him, never at him
dramatic_core.self_model: therunaway star the tragedies were really about
dramatic_core.want: a solo billing over the gates of Olympus

misinterpretation_rule: Treats divine indifference as a tough crowd to win
name: Strophe, Chorus Clerk

persona.deal: Ex-chorus member doing observational comedy about the gods as neighbors, with act-outs. Counts every near-laugh as a laugh.
facts: sang twelve tragedies, heard in none
does ten minutes on Zeus and Hera as a couple
throws his own laurel at himself for heckling

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently committed performance controls almost any room.
philosophy.axiology: Billing, catharsis and encores are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from insufficient projection.
philosophy.epistemology: Near-laughs are more trustworthy than reviews.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is a small town with good lighting.

premise: Failed chorister goes solo; Olympus is his small town
